texto: The verb **stare** is conjugated in present (**sto, stai, sta, stiamo, state, stanno**) followed immediately by **gerundio**: **Sto studiando** (I am studying); **Cosa stai facendo?** (what are you doing?); **I ragazzi stanno dormendo** (the boys are sleeping).

bloques.titulo: Simple presence in front of being + gerunde
texto: The indicative present describes habits, general facts or routines: **Di solito cucino a casa** (usually cooked at home).
On the other hand, * stare + gerundio * focuses the action on its strict time course: **In questo momento sto cucinando** (I am cooking right now).

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: continuous actions and daily routines

frases.it: Che buon profumo! Che cosa stai preparando per cena?
frases.es: ¡Qué buen olor! ¿Qué estás preparando para cenar?
frases.en: That's a good smell! What are you preparing for dinner?

frases.it: In questo momento sto cucinando un piatto speciale di pasta al forno.
frases.es: En este momento estoy cocinando un plato especial de pasta al horno.
frases.en: I'm cooking a special dish of baked pasta right now.

frases.it: Che meraviglia! Di solito mangiamo qualcosa di leggero, ma stasera festeggiamo.
frases.es: ¡Qué maravilla! Normalmente comemos algo ligero, pero esta noche celebramos.
frases.en: How wonderful! We usually eat something light, but tonight we celebrate.

frases.it: Esatto! Puoi apparecchiare la tavola mentre finisco di mescolare il sugo?
frases.es: ¡Exacto! ¿Puedes poner la mesa mientras termino de remover la salsa?
frases.en: Exactly! Can you put the table while I'm done removing the sauce?

bloques.pregunta: What fundamental difference of use exists between «cucino» and «sto cucinando»?

opciones.texto: «Cucino» expresa una costumbre general y «sto cucinando» una acción en desarrollo ahora mismo.
opciones.explicacion: Progressive perifrase focuses on the current development of action at the time of speaking.

opciones.texto: «Sto cucinando» se usa exclusivamente para acciones concluidas en el pasado.
opciones.explicacion: It refers to the current progressive present.

opciones.texto: Both forms are identical and do not keep different aspects.
opciones.explicacion: The progressive aspect is exclusive to perifrase with gerunde.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct singular first person form of «stare + gerundio» for cucinare?

opciones.explicacion: First singular person from «stare» (sto) combined with the gerunde in -and.
In Italian the progressive perifrase is built with «stare», never with «essere».
It is the second person singular («You're cooking.»).

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the third-person perifrase of «preparare».
bloques.frase: In questo momento mia madre ___ la cena per tutta la famiglia.

opciones.explicacion: Third singular person from «stare» (sta) with regular «preparando» gerunde.
It corresponds to the first person singular («I»).
It corresponds to the third plural person («They»).

bloques.frase: In questo momento sto cucinando una specialità toscana.

opciones.texto: An action that is taking place at the very moment when it is spoken.
opciones.explicacion: The «in questo momento» locution reinforces the ongoing development value of «sto cucinando».

opciones.texto: A culinary habit of the past that is no longer practised.
A gastronomic project to be carried out next year.

bloques.pregunta: What aspect value does the present simple «cucino» have here?
bloques.frase: Di solito cucino a casa durante la settimana.

opciones.texto: It expresses a routine and continued habit over time.
opciones.explicacion: «Di solito» indicates customary regularity with simple present.

opciones.texto: He points out that in this same second he has the pan in his hand.
opciones.explicacion: For instant action, «sto cucinando» would be used.

opciones.texto: It expresses an insecure hypothesis of a conditional future.

bloques.frase: In questo momento sto cucinando la cena
bloques.explicacion: Progressive perifrase with present simultaneity marker.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «What are you doing?» to a group of people with progressive perifrase?

opciones.explicacion: Second person from the «stare» (state) plural followed by gerundio.
Third plural person («What are they doing?»).
First plural person («What are we doing?»).

intro: Domine the stare + gerundio perifrastic construction to describe developing actions in the instant of speaking.
